name: general-purpose
last_assistant_message:
**[Rigby]: Structural gap closed — extended to `eval-agent-start.py`, not just plaud-ingest specifically.**

**What changed:**

- **`systems/eval-harness/hook_utils.py`** — extracted the `workflows/{name}/workflow.md` path-matching regex that `eval-turn-start.py`'s `detect_workflow()` already had into a shared `extract_workflow_path_reference()` (validates the match against a real file on disk, not just regex-shape). Both hooks now call this one implementation instead of two copies.
- **`eval-agent-start.py`** — new `detect_spawn_workflow()` checks the `SubagentStart` payload for a spawn-prompt-shaped field (tried `prompt`/`task`/`description`/`message`/`initial_prompt`, since this repo has no documented payload schema for that field name) and, if it names an explicit workflow.md path, writes it into a **new, additive `workflow` field** on the stub — `type`/`name` keep their existing, established meaning (`type: "agent"`, `name: "general-purpose"`) unchanged. I checked the field-naming question you flagged directly: `name` already means different things on `type: "workflow"` records (the workflow's name) vs `type: "agent"` records (the CC subagent type) — overloading it further would have been the third-inconsistent-field problem. `workflow` was already reserved-but-unused across every existing record I checked, so it's clean to introduce. `trigger` also flips to `"workflow-dispatch"` when this fires, instead of staying `"unknown"`.
- **`schema.md`** updated to document the new field and the `type: "agent"` case, which wasn't previously documented at all.

**Verified against real data, with one honest limitation:**

- Tested `detect_spawn_workflow()` against the *actual, real* dispatch instruction text from `workflows/boot/steps/step-01-load-context.md` ("Agent: Knox — run workflows/plaud-ingest/workflow.md. Background, don't wait.") — correctly resolves to `plaud-ingest`.
- Tested against my own two real capability-build dispatch prompts from earlier this session (the literal text I used to spawn the audit and hook-research forks) — both correctly stay untagged, confirming no false-match on genuinely ad-hoc, workflow-less dispatches.
- Also tested a missing-field payload and an alternate field-name variant — all pass, 6/6.
- **What I could not do**: literally replay the raw `SubagentStart` payloads for the 6 real Knox plaud-ingest records from today. That payload's prompt/task text was never persisted anywhere prior to this fix — there's no way to retroactively reconstruct exactly what was sent for those specific 6 records. I verified against the actual authored dispatch instruction that produces that text instead, which is the real source, but I want to be precise that this is not a byte-for-byte replay of those 6 records' original payloads.

Re-ran the 26-case `detect_workflow` regression suite after refactoring its path-check to the shared helper — no regressions. All hook files compile. `evolutions/.pending-changes.json` updated under the same `work-20260826-193329-eval-hook-lifecycle` item.
